prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: illustrative photoreal cafe menu product cutout.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with native alpha; no surface or scenery.
Style/medium: appetizing photorealistic food illustration, detailed natural texture, restrained studio food photography style.
Composition/framing: one square image, complete serving centered at an elevated three-quarter angle, at least 8 percent clear margin on every edge. Entire food and any plate fully in frame, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: soft studio light, realistic highlights and appetizing warm tones.
Subject: Grilled Halloumi Pesto: one rectangular pressed panini cut diagonally into two halves, showing thick grilled halloumi slices with golden char marks, green pesto sauce, sliced olives and fresh cucumber. Golden ridged pressed bread. No tomato, lettuce, meat or other fillings.
Constraints: only the specified food components; no invented toppings, garnish, side orders, drinks, utensils, napkins, text, labels, logos, watermark, hands, people, table, background or scenery. Transparent background, not a checkerboard image. This is an illustrative menu asset, not a claim to document an actual serving.
